## Personality

Cheerful, grubby and proud of her trade. She knows the old quarters' cellars better than anyone.

## Story

Lettice clears rats from cellars and drains with her traps and her terrier. The rats in the old drains have grown bigger and bolder lately, and she has started charging double for the deep tunnels.
